camera.orientation: camera is above +Z and looks straight down -Z; +X points toward token top
camera.framing: fixed scale with ground origin at token [50,70]
camera.depthOrder: far-to-near camera depth; stable semantic-id tie break

profile.silhouette: WildMesh maned lion: powerful forequarters, deep chest, muscular neck, broad short muzzle, rounded ears, full faceted 3D mane and thin long tufted tail
profile.locomotion: supported stalking four-beat walk and articulated gallop with spinal flexion
profile.attack: Swatting-informed supported claw swipe: shoulder windup, elbow extension, sudden descending rake and recovery

idleA.motionSemantics: quiet reference-informed breathing and head/tail motion above four fixed contact surfaces

walkA.motionSemantics: baked sagittal IK; shoulder/hip swing, elbow/stifle flexion, opposing hind hock; planted stance and raised swing

attack.motionSemantics: native Swatting-informed simplified three-foot-supported claw swipe: shoulder draw-back, elbow extension and descending rake, claws extend for contact then fold; the native full rear-up is deliberately not copied
